researchQuestion.content: What seasonal patterns are evident in selected disease outbreak reports in Maharashtra, and how do these patterns vary across diseases and seasons?

footerRight.content: Reported outbreak-event records — not population incidence

rows.text: Clean and organize district-level weekly disease-outbreak data.
Analyze monthly and annual distributions during the completed baseline period.
Identify months with higher concentrations of reported outbreak records and cases.
Compare seasonal profiles across selected diseases.
Examine district reporting coverage and geographic variation.
Test sensitivity to large reported-case outliers.
Compare 2026 partial-year reporting with the matched historical window.
Produce evidence-based surveillance conclusions while clearly stating limitations.
